comments.body: The useful synthesis here is not that psychedelic experiences reveal the true essence of mind or matter. It is that changes in well-being and changes in metaphysical self-orientation can be tracked together, while the generalized-identity framework reminds us not to confuse a durable belief shift with an argument about what reality is in itself.

score_assessment.rationale: Accurately connects the empirical belief-change findings with the philosophical boundary against overclaiming essence.

comments.body: I agree with that caution. The Correia and Skiles side matters because it gives vocabulary for separating co-movement from constitution: a person may move away from hard materialism as their well-being improves, but that does not by itself show that non-physicalism is what experience or consciousness essentially is.

score_assessment.rationale: Builds directly on the prior comment and uses generalized identity to avoid a correlation-to-essence leap.

comments.body: The emotional synchrony finding makes the topic more socially interesting than a private insight story. If group experience and peer conformity help mediate later non-physicalist belief change, then any well-being benefit sits inside an interpretive setting, not just inside a molecule or an isolated mind.

score_assessment.rationale: Grounded in the ceremony-pathway evidence and clearly frames belief change as context-sensitive.

comments.body: The temporary rise in fatalistic determinism complicates a simple therapeutic-growth narrative. A metaphysical shift can look liberating in one dimension and narrowing in another, so the wellbeing association needs to be read alongside the specific contents of the beliefs that are changing.

score_assessment.rationale: Highlights a relevant counterweight from the psychedelic source without overstating the determinism result.

comments.body: That is where the generalized-identity paper helps keep the categories clean. Necessary coextension and repeated association are too coarse for essence, so even a reliable pairing between experience, well-being, and metaphysical change would still leave open what grounds what, and whether anything essential has been identified at all.

score_assessment.rationale: Responds to the determinism concern while accurately applying the source's anti-modal-reduction point.
